assets.prompt: Paint one isolated fantasy inventory icon of **Wilted Sprig, F grade**. Input 1 is the SUBJECT IDENTITY reference only: retain its single bent ochre-brown stem and two drooping brown/olive leaves, including the curled lower-right leaf and torn, depleted character. Interpret its chunky pixel forms as natural painted shapes; do not copy its pixel grid, black outline or magenta background. Input 2 is the STYLE reference only: match its soft painterly material shading, restrained top-left light, muted colors and clear small-icon finish. Do not borrow its bottle or red liquid. No checkerboard, transparency visualization, gradient, light spill, vignette, contact/ground shadow or floor. The magenta is a temporary technical background that will be keyed out for the game.

Do not borrow the bottle or red liquid. Natural painted metal, no black contour, pixel grid, cartoon outlines, polished armor, gold treasure, complete tool or weapon, added chain, frame or text. A slight elevated three-quarter view, readable plate separation, matte rust and a few cool exposed edge highlights. Keep the whole heap centered inside the square with even clear magenta padding, occupying about 85% of the width. One complete compact item only; paint every fragment consistently. Keep ALL magenta out of the metal itself.
